name: give_item
description: Adds an item to a character's or NPC's equipment list. If quantity > 1, the item is stored as a single grouped entry (e.g., 'Arrow (x50)') rather than N separate entries.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a player character or an NPC.

entity.description: The slug or UUID of the character or NPC.

item.description: The item to add (e.g., 'Longsword +1', 'Potion of Healing', 'Arrow').

quantity.description: Number of items to add. If > 1, stored as 'item (xN)' (e.g., 'Arrow (x50)'). Defaults to 1.
